name: android.permission.CAMERA
description: Allows access to the device camera. High-risk for covert surveillance especially when combined with a foreground service, allowing for access even switching to another application.

name: android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO
description: Allows recording of audio from the microphone, a functionality that can trivially be repurposed to allow for surveillance.

name: android.permission.WAKE_LOCK
description: Prevents the device CPU from sleeping. While common in legitimate use cases (e.g. video players), in dual-use contexts it facilitates continuous background processing which may be done without user awareness.

name: android.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW
description: Allows drawing overlays on top of other applications, a classic vector for UI redressing attacks (tapjacking) and hiding status indicators from the user.

name: android.permission.BLUETOOTH_ADMIN
description: Enables control over Bluetooth settings and discovery. Legacy permission largely deprecated in modern Android versions (Android 12+), with limited functionality remaining.

name: android.permission.BLUETOOTH_SCAN
description: Allows scanning for nearby Bluetooth devices (BLE discovery). Can be used as a proximity-based side channel for location inference.

name: android.permission.WRITE_SETTINGS
description: Allows modification of system settings (e.g., screen timeout, volume) however it is not very powerful. Often used by parental control apps but can mask device behavior changes.

name: android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS
description: Grants access to protected system settings (requires root, ADB, or system signature). Extremely powerful and not available to third-party apps.

name: android.permission.INSTALL_PACKAGES
description: Allows silent installation of applications. Highly restricted and only available to system-level or privileged apps.

name: android.permission.REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES
description: Allows an app to request installation of other packages via user approval flow. Can be abused for staged malware delivery.

name: android.permission.BIND_DEVICE_ADMIN
description: Allows an app to act as a device administrator by interacting with the Android Device Administration API. It allows for screen locking, preventing uninstallation and device wiping. Deprecated with Android 9.0.

name: android.permission.BIND_ACCESSIBILITY_SERVICE
description: Allows declaration of an accessibility service that can observe and interact with the UI. Once enabled by the user in settings, it can read screen content and simulate input actions.

name: android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION
description: Provides approximate location via network (Wi-Fi/Cell tower). Used for coarse tracking and location inference, easily repurposed for real-time surveillance.

name: android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION
description: Provides precise GPS location. Enables real-time tracking capabilities.

name: android.permission.ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION
description: Allows continuous location access in the background even when the app is not actively in use.

name: android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_LOCATION
description: Allows location access within a foreground service, which shows in a notification. Does not grant location permission itself but enables persistent tracking when combined with location access.

name: android.permission.ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION
description: Allows detection of physical movement (walking, driving, cycling).

name: com.google.android.gms.permission.ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION
description: Google Play Services variant for activity detection on devices where Google Play Services implementation is required.

name: android.permission.ACCESS_WIFI_STATE
description: Allows access to Wi-Fi connection state and SSID information. Can be used for coarse indoor location inference using signal strength and SSIDs.

name: android.permission.NEARBY_WIFI_DEVICES
description: Allows scanning nearby Wi-Fi devices without requiring full location permission (Android 13+). Can be used for proximity inference.

name: android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE
description: Allows monitoring of network connectivity state, which can provide extremely coarse location inference based on the device connection made (Wi-Fi, mobile data, none).

name: android.permission.CHANGE_WIFI_STATE
description: Allows enabling/disabling Wi-Fi. Can be used to force reconnections, especially for evil twin attacks.

name: android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MICROPHONE
description: Enables microphone access as a foreground service (meaning the microphone is still accessed while the app appears to be minimised). This does show up in a notification. Requires microphone permission separately for actual audio capture.

name: android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_CAMERA
description: Enables camera access as a foreground service (meaning the camera is still accessed while the app appears to be minimised). This does show up in a notification. Requires camera permission separately for actual capture.

name: android.permission.ACCESS_NOTIFICATION_POLICY
description: Allows modification of Do Not Disturb settings, can be used to suppress or allow notifications selectively.

name: android.permission.BIND_NOTIFICATION_LISTENER_SERVICE
description: Allows reading all system notifications including messages from messaging apps (WhatsApp, SMS previews, etc.). Requires explicit user enabling in settings.

name: android.permission.RECEIVE_SMS
description: Allows receiving and reading SMS messages including one-time passwords (OTP).

name: android.permission.READ_MEDIA_AUDIO
description: Allows access to audio files stored on device media storage.

name: android.permission.READ_MEDIA_IMAGES
description: Allows access to image files stored on device media storage.

name: android.permission.READ_MEDIA_VIDEO
description: Allows access to video files stored on device media storage.

name: android.permission.READ_CALL_LOG
description: Allows access to call history metadata including numbers and timestamps.

name: android.permission.ACCESS_MEDIA_LOCATION
description: Allows extraction of geolocation metadata embedded in media files (photos/videos).

name: android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED
description: Allows application to start automatically after device reboot, supporting persistence mechanisms.

name: android.permission.REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS
description: Allows exemption from Android power-saving restrictions, enabling more persistent background execution.

name: android.permission.REQUEST_DELETE_PACKAGES
description: Allows requesting uninstallation of applications with user confirmation per action.
